_comment: Benjamin, at the beet field east of Flora's house, teaches Harvest; talking to him is an objective of `ready-for-harvest`. A Beet takes damage only from a `harvest`-tagged aura. Standing talkable-NPC shape (miller.json): townsfolk, collisionLayer 97 without Action(2) so no aura targets it, role creature + speed 0, xpFactor 0. Dialogue from the PO's quest sheet. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: Benjamin

lines: Hello, stranger. What can I do for you?

options.text: Flora sends me to harvest the beets.

lines: Ah good, I'm glad she sent some help.

options.text: Can I just pull them out of the ground?

lines: That won't work. You need to have the Harvest aura active.
You can only have one active aura at a time. The new auras you learn, you'll find in your spellbook.
I can teach you the Harvest aura.
Harvesting is done standing, close to the plant.

grants.line: I'll teach you Harvest. Make it your active aura and stand close to the beets.
